title: Puzzle 3D React Parity
description: Restore premigration parity for puzzle 3D in the React renderer: GLB coordinate frame, hover/select/gumball/marquee protocol, scene layers (vortices/attractions/target volumes/references/brush preview), and Select/Brush/Fill window engagements.
summary:
Finished puzzle 3d end to end: `bun run dev:puzzle:3d` was failing to build and the running app could not dispatch any plugin actions, both due to unfinished Command→Action rename fallout from the RENAME-WINDOW-COMMAND-TO-ACTION rename in framework core.

Fixes:
- vcs/rs/lib.rs: `UndoPolicy::CompensatingCommand` → `UndoPolicy::CompensatingAction` (the compile error that aborted the plugin build).
- framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs: five stale `command:` field initializers on `UiTreeItemAction`/`UiTreeItemNode` → `action:` (broke every plugin crate build, surfaced via cad/dag).
- framework/product/os/dev/script.ts: the generated plugin web worker and jco component bridge still spoke `handleCommand`/`commandJson` while the JS host (framework/core/js) and the WIT world had moved to `handleAction` — renamed the worker message case and the bridge api to `handleAction`/`actionJson`. This was the cause of the runtime `api.handleAction is not a function` errors that made every click/action in the booted app fail silently.
- framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.ts: renamed the worker-protocol client and bridge adapter to handleAction and switched the import to `patchOpsFromActionResponse` (old symbol no longer exists in core); regenerated the bundled framework/renderer/wgpu/js/boot.js via `bun build`.
- framework/renderer/wgpu/index.test.ts: stub field `handleCommand` → `handleAction`.
- Rebuilt all 22 plugin wasm modules + bridges into framework/product/os/dev/plugin-modules so the dev server serves handleAction-speaking bridges for every plugin.

Verified live in the browser at the puzzle-3d-react-dev server (port 6013): app boots to "semio · puzzle · 3d", Concrete Forest example loads and renders in the 3D viewport, clicking the object selects it (red highlight + translate gumball), the Inspection panel shows the selection (Id seed-left-001, Label/Kind), Brush/Fill engagement switching works, and the Action command line accepts input — all of which round-trip through the renamed handleAction path with no more console errors. Tests: vcs 18 pass, semio-framework-plugin 16 pass, puzzle-plugin d3:: 81 pass, react renderer 69 pass, wgpu renderer 2 pass.

Out of scope, flagged as a separate background task: the wgpu Rust renderer stack (framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs ~178 refs, infinite/world/rs/lib.rs ~59 refs) still uses the removed CommandDescriptor/CommandResult/handleCommand naming and does not compile — that is the remaining sweep of the rename ticket, not part of the puzzle 3d react path.
